words.gloss: that which is huge in size

literal: Even though it is huge and has sharp tusks, the elephant will fear if a tiger attacks.
translation: Although the elephant is immense in size and armed with sharp tusks, it will tremble in fear if a tiger attacks.
modern: யானை மிகப்பெரிய உடலையும் கூர்மையான தந்தங்களையும் கொண்டிருந்தாலும், ஒரு புலி தன்னைத் தாக்கினால் அது அஞ்சி நடுங்கும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights that physical size and external weapons are useless without inner courage and determination. The elephant is massive and possesses deadly, sharp tusks, yet it shudders in fear when confronted by a fierce tiger. The tiger, though much smaller, possesses the relentless drive and spirit to attack. For a learner, this teaches that true strength lies in one's inner resolve and motivation, not in outward appearance or resources.
